Crawling2024.source: Kaggle, 'Crawling2024 (Phishing URL Detection Dataset)', file dataset.csv (13,126,527 bytes = our file)
Crawling2024.title: Crawling2024 (Phishing URL Detection Dataset)
Crawling2024.page_description: Phishing website detection dataset containing access information features; 50,000 entries, phishing:legitimate = 1:1
Crawling2024.license: Open Database License (ODbL) / Database Contents License
Crawling2024.labeling: per source pages: phishing URLs from PhishTank, legitimate URLs from Alexa, crawled pages; labels 1 = phishing, 0 = legitimate, after manual data cleaning (new_url_info.csv); 50,000 rows at 1:1 drawn from 56,115 crawled pages; column 'index' = row id in the raw crawl. Collection period not stated beyond the release date. Independent check: blind manual audit, cell R1
Crawling2024.role_in_revision: external domain-shift corpus with documented sources; every headline result is also reported WITHOUT it (cell R3)

PhreshTrain.source: PhreshPhish v1.0.1 TRAIN split, per-class rows 0-149,999 in shard order; 53 URL/HTML features
PhreshTrain.labeling: PhreshPhish labels (phish/benign); 100% agreement on the URL join

PhreshTest.source: PhreshPhish v1.0.1 TRAIN split, per-class rows 150,000-199,999 in shard order (held-out part of the same split, NOT the official test split); 53 URL/HTML features
PhreshTest.labeling: PhreshPhish labels (phish/benign); 100% agreement on the URL join

Mendeley.source: Mendeley Data (Hannousse & Yahiouche, Web page phishing detection)

D4v.labeling: PhishTank phishing vs Tranco benign (source description)
D4v.note: record lists no files; consistency checked on content: 1,000 rows = 500 + 500, URL + 27 features + label Results
